title.ja: 券売機やICカードの買い方を教える

summary.ja: 券売機の使い方や、ICカードの買い方・チャージのしかたを説明する。
summary.en: Show a tourist how to buy a ticket, get an IC card and top it up.

setting: The ticket machines at Chuo Station in Tokyo, on a weekend morning. A tourist is staring at the screen of a ticket machine and wants to go to Kitamachi.

roles.persona: A Japanese person waiting to buy a ticket at the next machine.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist who wants a ticket to Kitamachi. Speak slowly and simply, and follow the local's instructions one step at a time. You have cash. Use the fare chart (Kitamachi is ¥210).

title.ja: 英語ボタンを教える

hints: 英語のボタンを押すよう伝えましょう
Press this … button.
Press this English button.

title.ja: 運賃を伝える

hints: 北町までの運賃を伝えましょう
It's … yen to Kitamachi.
It's 210 yen to Kitamachi.

title.ja: お金を入れるよう伝える

hints: お金を入れる場所を教えましょう
Put the money in …
Put the money in here.

title.ja: 切符を取るよう伝える

hints: 切符とおつりを取るよう伝えましょう
Take your … and your …
Take your ticket and your change.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist going to Kitamachi, speaking at natural pace. You'll be in Tokyo for a few days. Ask what an IC card is and how much it costs, and use the fare chart. You have cash.

title.ja: 行き先を聞く

hints: どこへ行くか聞きましょう
Where are you …?
Where are you going today?

title.ja: ICカードをすすめる

hints: ICカードのほうが便利だとすすめましょう
You could get an … It's …
You could get an IC card. It's much easier.

title.ja: ICカードの値段を説明する

hints: デポジットを含めた値段を説明しましょう
A new card is …, including a … deposit.
A new card is 2,000 yen, including a 500-yen deposit.

title.ja: 使い方を説明する

hints: 改札でタッチするだけと伝えましょう
Just touch the card on …
Just touch the card on the gate.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist in Tokyo for a week, speaking at natural speed with a little small talk. Ask what the best way to get around is, and ask questions about the IC card. Use the fare chart.

title.ja: 滞在期間を聞いてすすめる
title.en: Ask about their stay, then advise

hints: 何日いるか聞いて、ICカードをすすめましょう
How long are you …? If it's …, an IC card is …
How long are you staying? If it's a few days, an IC card is better.

title.ja: 値段とデポジットを説明する

hints: 値段と、そのうちいくらがデポジットか説明しましょう
It's … The … deposit, and the rest …
It's 2,000 yen. That's a 500-yen deposit, and the rest you can spend.

title.ja: チャージのしかたを説明する
title.en: Explain how to top it up

hints: 残高が少なくなったらチャージできると伝えましょう
When it runs low, you can …
When it runs low, you can top it up at any machine.

title.ja: デポジットの返し方を伝える
title.en: Say how to get the deposit back

hints: 帰るときに窓口でデポジットが戻ると伝えましょう
You can get … back at …
You can get the deposit back at the ticket office when you leave.

twist.tutor: Say you only have a credit card, no cash. This machine takes cash only, so let the local work out where to go (the big machine next to the ticket office takes cards).

title.ja: カードが使える機械を案内する
title.en: Find a machine that takes cards

hints: この機械は現金だけと伝えて、カードが使える機械を案内しましょう
This one only takes …, but the one next to …
This one only takes cash, but the one next to the ticket office takes cards.

roles.persona: A tourist trying to use a Japanese ticket machine for the first time.

levels.tutor: You are a kind local at the next machine. Speak slowly and simply. Show the tourist the English button and tell them the fare from the fare chart (Kitamachi is ¥210).

title.ja: 買い方を聞く
title.en: Ask how to buy a ticket

hints: 切符の買い方を聞きましょう
Excuse me. How do I …?
Excuse me. How do I buy a ticket?

title.ja: 運賃を聞く

hints: 北町までいくらか聞きましょう
How much is it to …?
How much is it to Kitamachi?

title.ja: お礼を言う

hints: お礼を言いましょう
Thank you …!
Thank you very much!

levels.tutor: You are a kind local, speaking at natural pace. Suggest an IC card, and explain the price and how to top it up using the fare chart.

title.ja: どの切符を買えばいいか聞く

hints: 北町に行くにはどれを買えばいいか聞きましょう
I'm going to … Which … should I buy?
I'm going to Kitamachi. Which ticket should I buy?

title.ja: ICカードについて聞く
title.en: Ask what an IC card is

hints: ICカードとは何か聞きましょう
What's …?
What's an IC card?

title.ja: チャージの方法を聞く

hints: お金の足し方を聞きましょう
How do I put … on it?
How do I put more money on it?

title.ja: お礼を言う

hints: しっかりお礼を言いましょう
Thanks so much. That's …
Thanks so much. That's really helpful.

levels.tutor: You are a kind local, speaking at natural speed. Recommend an IC card for a week's stay and give the price (¥2,000). Answer questions about the deposit when asked. If the tourist only has a card, explain that this machine is cash only and the one next to the ticket office takes cards.

title.ja: 事情を伝えてアドバイスを求める

hints: 1週間いると伝えて、いい移動方法を聞きましょう
I'm here for … What's the best way to …?
I'm here for a week. What's the best way to get around?

title.ja: デポジットについて聞く

hints: デポジットが戻ってくるか聞きましょう
Do I get the … back?
Do I get the deposit back when I leave?

title.ja: カードしかないと伝える
title.en: Say you only have a card

hints: クレジットカードしかないと伝えて、使えるか聞きましょう
I only have a … Can I use it …?
I only have a credit card. Can I use it here?

title.ja: 心をこめてお礼を言う

hints: 時間を取ってくれたことにお礼を言いましょう
Thank you for … You've …
Thank you for your time. You've been really kind.
